title: US home sauna planning and comparisons
description: Source-based US sauna comparisons for choosing by space, capacity, placement and electrical requirements.
heading: Find the right sauna for your space.
introduction: The US catalog brings together indoor and outdoor cabins, sauna kits and infrared systems as their model details are documented and checked. Each record keeps placement, seating, dimensions and electrical supply attached to the exact product or configuration.

Use the catalog for a broad view, compare specific configurations, or start with the finder when room, power and capacity set the boundaries. This is source-based comparison, not a hands-on test or installation approval.

sections.heading: What the growing catalog covers
paragraphs: The catalog covers sauna cabins and kits for indoor and outdoor use, including infrared and traditional systems. New models are added when their product details can be documented from reliable sources.
Coverage is not equally deep for every record. Installation clearances, shipping terms, circuit requirements and package contents remain open wherever the reviewed source does not state them clearly.

sections.heading: Every model keeps its own source record
paragraphs: Manufacturer product pages and official collection references provide the source material. Evidence is recorded at field level, so an unknown clearance or circuit value stays visible instead of being filled from a related model.
A finder result narrows the available options. It does not replace the model instructions, local requirements or review by a qualified professional.

sections.heading: Choose a starting point
paragraphs: Browse the catalog when you want to see the full set of documented models. Use the finder to narrow the list by space, capacity and power, then open a product page to review the source-backed details.
